title: Old Radio Advertisements
paragraphs: Synthetic GRH archive collection of undated radio commercial and promotional clips. It is not treated as one historical broadcast series.
The stories often return to Tobacco advertising, Automotive advertising, Personal care advertising, Health and remedy advertising, Food and beverage advertising, and Network and program promotion.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Commercial radio advertising archive.
plain_text:
